title: Hostility Detection in UK Politics: A Dataset on Online Abuse Targeting MPs
reasoning: The paper includes religion as one of its four primary target identity characteristics for hostility detection. It defines religion-based hostility (including Islamophobia and antisemitism), provides specific examples, and benchmarks the performance of various models, including Large Language Models like LLaMA-3 and GPT-3.5, on their ability to classify such content.
